answer_1.quote: ...target-driven conversation generation...We propose a novel two-stage framework...to guide target-driven conversation generation.
answer_1.outputs: Natural-language conversation plans and full dialogue responses for movie recommendation tasks.

answer_2.quote: We adopt the same evaluation metrics, including perplexity (PPL), distinct (D-1/2), BLEU-n (B-1/2), word‑level F1 and knowledge F1 (Know. F1)...We also use BERTScore, BARTScore, EntityCov and Coherence as automatic metrics.

answer_4.quote: We recruited 5 master students to serve as annotators for this project...At least two different annotators rated each dialogue example.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated each dialogue on a four‑level Likert scale (0–3) for several criteria.
